issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: NUWAY Alliance Agrees to Pay $18,500,000 Settlement in Medicaid Kickbacks Scheme, False Claims Act Violations
jurisdiction: Minnesota Medicaid / federal False Claims Act
supports: NUWAY Alliance agreed to pay $18.5 million to resolve allegations involving Minnesota Medicaid substance-use-disorder treatment claims.

The federal release alleges that from January 2019 through February 2025 NUWAY compensated Medicaid patients for seeking reimbursable intensive outpatient treatment in violation of the Anti-Kickback Statute, causing false Medicaid claims.
The federal release also alleges NUWAY double-billed overlapping periods of treatment for services not provided as separately claimed.
NUWAY entered a five-year HHS-OIG Corporate Integrity Agreement requiring a compliance program and independent review of Medicaid claims.
The Minnesota Attorney General states Minnesota will receive more than $8 million from the settlement.
important_qualifications: The federal release expressly states the claims resolved are allegations and there was no determination of liability or wrongdoing.
The $8M Minnesota share is nested within the $18.5M total and must not be added to it.
Because the settlement occurred in FY2025 and involved Minnesota MFCU, it may overlap HHS-OIG's quoted Minnesota MFCU FY2025 >$24M total monetary recoveries; do not sum without a component breakdown.
